Class ItemStackBuilders

java.lang.Object
io.github.kaivian.klibrary.itemstack.builder.ItemStackBuilders
public final class ItemStackBuilders extends Object
Static entry point for creating ItemStackBuilder instances.

Example usage:

ItemStack item = ItemStackBuilders.of(Material.DIAMOND_SWORD)
    .with(ItemModifiers.display().name("<red>Fire Sword</red>"))
    .with(ItemModifiers.enchant(Enchantment.SHARPNESS, 5))
    .build();
